main_text.l: ctes[?] Hieronymus ipse Latinus; idem hoc [?]estinus, alij; præsto sunt exempla; rationes etiam adsunt & causæ motæ controversiæ: Et tamen, si Baronio credimus, Latinorum nemo, nec per somnium, Epistolæ vel authorem vel authoritatem traxit in dubium? Nec ante nec post Concilij Nicæni tempora? Constantissimè à Romanis & Catholicis omnibus Pauli habita? Calumnia fuerit Eusebÿ & error Hieronymi? Hæccine est fides purpurati hoccine nodum solvere, an implicare & ludibrium debere sententiæ adversæ patronis?

XII. Nos vero & rem totam illustramus, & quid de Latinis in hac causâ sentiendum, quid de tempore motæ inter Latinos controversiæ, causis, authoribus, quid denique de vi exceptionis suprà positæ, declaramus paucis. Primò itaque negamus, de Epistolâ inter Latinos fuisse controversum primis duobus sæculis, vel certè ante inclinationem secundi. Imò vero Pauli creditam illâ ætate conjecta-

page.notes: The top line is blotted and partly unreadable; "ctes" and the italic word after "idem hoc" (read as Festinus, "[?]estinus") are doubtful. The running head and page number are set in heavy, damaged type; "Epistolæ" is uncertain. The line "Nec ante nec post" and the words "Pauli habita" are slightly smudged but legible. The last line "mus" at the lower right is treated as the catchword.
